screens.prompt:
Design an ORIGINAL consumer wallet overview for LedgerFlow, an Indonesian payment SIMULATOR, with Direction A "Bold everyday". This is a new design exploration replacing the rejected indigo card-stack. Shared design system: cream #F5F3E9, electric lime #D9F05B, ink #202B25. Light theme, no dark page background. Space Grotesk display and IBM Plex Sans body with tabular Rupiah figures. Aim for a memorable useful wallet, disciplined asymmetry, large numbers, generous breathing room, one main visual focal point. No stock photos, crypto illustrations, generic gradient blob art, banking cards, QR code, charts, budget widgets, rewards, notification bell, investment, shopping/merchant payments, or unsupported feature promotions. Original two-dot connecting-line symbol subtly suggests money movement. All content in Indonesian.
Fictional fixture: name Dira; available balance Rp 1.250.000; single currency; small "Simulasi" label in header. Main action "Kirim uang", supporting "Isi saldo" and "Terima" (Terima opens wallet-ID sharing, not a QR function). Recent activity 3 flat rows with thin dividers: "Isi saldo simulasi" +Rp 500.000 · Hari ini, 09.41; "Ke Raka" −Rp 150.000 · Kemarin, 14.22; "Dari Naya" +Rp 200.000 · Kemarin, 10.03. Distinguish incoming and outgoing with icon direction, text and signed amount; do not rely on color alone. "Lihat semua" opens paginated history. Header logout "Keluar"; no profile-management page implied. Brief copy "Dana latihan, bukan uang nyata." placed quietly once. Entire wallet ID stays behind Terima, not a big homepage UUID block. Touch targets >=44px, clear readable muted text. Snapshot only, no need functional backend or fake live metrics.
Generate exactly ONE MOBILE home screen titled "A1 — Lime balance / Mobile", about 390px wide and 844px viewport. Layout A1: compact branded header and Dira greeting; broad lime BALANCE HERO with 24px internal padding, label "Saldo tersedia", huge 42–48px balance and dark primary send button. Topup and receive below as two quiet secondary actions, not three giant equal tiles. Reserve a small original line-arrow motif at the edge of the hero without obscuring money. The remaining page stays cream. Flat activity feed directly underneath, not enclosed in three cards. Compact two-item bottom navigation "Beranda" and "Aktivitas"; logout in header. First viewport must include balance, all actions and at least two activity rows, no long scrolling decorative intro.
